transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brings you in today?

I... well, I suppose I'm here because of work. I try to explain things to my team—like the inventory numbers, or, you know, the weekend schedule. But... it doesn't come out right. I start talking about the delivery trucks, and then Thursdays, and somehow the church grill gets mixed in... and the way my boss sounded earlier. People just stare at me. They can't follow it. I don't really know why it's happening.
Can you describe what goes through your mind when you're trying to explain something to your team? Do your thoughts feel connected or do they jump around?

I just... I'm trying to tell them what they need to know. Like the inventory numbers, or the weekend schedule. But my mind... it just jumps. One second I'm talking about the delivery trucks, and then I'm thinking about Thursdays, and then... somehow the church grill comes up. Or the tone my boss used earlier. It all feels connected to me when I'm saying it, but... they just look at me. Like they can't follow it at all.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts are being put into your mind by someone else, or that others can hear your thoughts?
No... no, I haven't felt anything like that. Just... what I told you. About the talking.
Have you ever experienced things that others around you don't seem to experience—like hearing voices when no one is speaking or seeing things that others don't see?
No... nothing like that. I don't hear voices or see things. It's just... what I told you. Just the trouble with talking at work.
Have you ever had thoughts that other people would find very strange or hard to understand, even when you're not trying to explain something at work?
No. Not really. Just... normal thoughts, I guess. Nothing strange. Just the work stuff I mentioned.
Have you ever had beliefs or thoughts that you know are unusual, even if you haven’t shared them with others?
No. I don't think so. I mean... I don't really know what you consider unusual, but... no. I just think about regular things. Managing the store, getting through the week. That's it.
Have you ever had experiences where you saw, heard, or felt things that others around you don’t seem to notice?
I... no. I feel like you already asked me that. I don't hear or see anything strange. It's just... no. Like I said, I just go to the store and do my job. That's all.
Have you ever believed something very strongly that others around you didn’t agree with, even though there was no clear evidence to support it?

I... no. I don't... I don't get into arguments about things like that. I just... I keep to myself mostly. I don't have time to worry about what other people agree with or don't agree with. I just focus on my work.
Outside of work, do you ever find your thoughts jumping around or being hard to follow when you're speaking to friends or family?

I don't really... I don't see a lot of people outside of work. But... I guess that's sort of why I came in today. It happens at the store, mostly. I'll try to explain the inventory numbers, or the weekend schedule, and... my words just start jumping around. Like, from the delivery trucks, to Thursdays, to the church grill, to my boss's tone of voice. And people just... they look at me like they can't follow what I'm saying. So... yeah. I guess it happens.
Outside of the communication problems you’ve described at work, have you had any difficulties getting along with others or maintaining your usual level of functioning in other areas of your life?

I... well, I guess things haven't been great. At the store... they took me off the busy weekend shifts. My boss gave me a performance review recently and... he said I could be suspended if things don't improve. 

And... at home... I just stay out of the way mostly. My wife has had to cover the commitments I used to handle. I guess... people were getting uncomfortable around me, or confused. So she just does it now. That's... that's about it.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to take care of yourself, like keeping up with personal hygiene, or in your motivation to do things you used to enjoy?

No. I... I take care of myself fine. I shower and... get dressed for work. As for doing things... I mostly just work anyway. I've never really had a lot of hobbies. So... no, I haven't noticed anything like that.
Do the times when your thoughts feel disorganized and your speech jumps around happen only at work, or do they also occur even when you're not at work or under stress?
I don't know... I guess it happens other times, too. It's not just work. But I... I don't really talk to a lot of people otherwise. So... I'm not sure.

Do the times when your thoughts feel disorganized and your speech jumps around happen even when you're not stressed or in a pressured situation, or does it only happen when you're feeling under stress?

I... I don't really know. I haven't kept track of it like that. I guess... maybe? I just... I'm not sure if it's about being stressed or not. Like I said, I don't talk much when I'm at home, so... I just don't know.
Can you think of any time when your thoughts or speech felt disorganized or hard to follow when you weren't at work or feeling stressed?

I just... I can't really think of a specific time. When I'm not at work, I'm mostly just by myself. I don't really have anyone to talk to, so... I don't know if my speech is disorganized then. I just... I don't know.
Can you think of any time when you were relaxed or at home and not at work, where your thoughts felt jumbled or your speech was hard to follow, even if no one else was around to notice it?
I don't... I just don't pay attention to it like that. When I'm alone, I'm just alone. I'm not... talking to myself. So I really couldn't tell you.
Have you ever noticed your thoughts feeling jumbled or your speech being hard to follow even when you're by yourself, like when you're just thinking or maybe talking out loud a little?
No... I don't talk out loud. And my thoughts... they're just my thoughts. I haven't noticed them being jumbled or anything. It's just quiet.
Have you ever noticed your thoughts feeling jumbled or hard to follow when you're completely relaxed and not trying to talk to anyone, like when you're just sitting quietly by yourself?
I just... I've already said no. When I'm sitting quietly, it's just quiet. There's nothing to follow. I don't know what else to tell you.

Can you recall any time when you were completely alone and relaxed, not under any pressure or trying to talk to anyone, where your thoughts felt disorganized or jumbled on the inside, even if no one else could see or hear it?
I... I don't have a different answer for you. No. Like I just said, my mind is fine when I'm by myself. I don't really know why we keep going over this.
